_about: Ranks + XP (v1 numbers, design/progression.md). A shift's final score becomes XP; rank comes from all the XP ever earned. xpToNext(rank) = xpBase + xpPerRank × rank. Every shift earns at least max(minXp, minXpPerRank × rank).
_activeSlots: F34: how many active upgrades (Cooldown Booster…) can be taken into a shift at once. v1: 1, then 2 with Active Expansion Slot (rank 20) and 3 with the second (rank 38).
_unlocks: F59 (Muzzy, 2026-10-19): the rank each part of the game unlocks at. nextPiece = the next-piece window at the top of the tank · swap = trading the falling piece with the next one (hold Right Shift / R, or hold still on the tank) · upgrades = the Upgrades button on the console opens (scraps bank from rank 1 either way). The machines unlock in breakdowns.json (unlockRank).
_titles: F35: the rank each title starts at (design/story.md 'Rank titles'); words: en.json story.titles. The 12th title is the win, not a rank (F65). A new title shows on the payday that reaches it.
